policy.ai_summary: 肯尼亚监管机构寻求区块链工具监控加密犯罪。
policy.industry_action: 关注肯尼亚的加密监管动态

policy.title: Coinbase Wins UK License to Offer Stocks and Derivatives Alongside Crypto
policy.description: The FCA authorization lets the exchange offer equities and derivatives to UK users, a step toward its "everything exchange" ambitions.
policy.ai_summary: Coinbase获得英国许可证，扩展业务范围。
policy.industry_action: 关注竞争对手的业务扩展动态

funding.title: Coinbase secures UK investment services license to add derivatives and equities trading
funding.description: Coinbase secured a UK investment services license to offer derivatives and equities trading in addition to crypto.
funding.ai_summary: Coinbase获得英国投资服务许可证，扩展交易业务。
funding.industry_action: 关注监管变化对市场的影响
